text_block_list.text:
After a fierce battle, Уиннинг Тикит
comes out
on top at the Japanese
Derby.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Everyone celebrates the racer for finally
fulfilling
her dream. It's a dazzling sight
for Нарита Таисин.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But she's not one to settle for anything
but first
place.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Таисин reaffirms her dedication to
keep
pushing on, so she can seize
victory at the final
race of the Triple
Crown tour—the Kikuka Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
